香肠.zh: 早饭我吃了两根香肠和一个鸡蛋。
香肠.en: For breakfast I had two sausages and an egg.

相当.zh: 这次考试相当难，很多人没通过。
相当.en: This exam was quite hard; many people didn't pass.

相似.zh: 这两种文化有很多相似的地方。
相似.en: These two cultures have a lot in common.

想念.zh: 出国以后，我常常想念家乡的饭菜。
想念.en: Since going abroad, I often miss the food from my hometown.

享受.zh: 退休以后，他开始享受轻松的生活。
享受.en: After retiring, he began to enjoy a relaxed life.

项链.zh: 这条项链是妈妈送给我的生日礼物。
项链.en: This necklace was a birthday present from my mom.

象征.zh: 在中国文化中，红色象征着幸福和好运。
象征.en: In Chinese culture, red symbolizes happiness and good luck.

消极.zh: 遇到困难时，不要有消极的想法。
消极.en: When you run into difficulties, don't think negatively.

消失.zh: 他的身影很快就消失在人群中。
消失.en: His figure quickly disappeared into the crowd.

小气.zh: 他太小气了，从来不请朋友吃饭。
小气.en: He's so stingy that he never treats his friends to a meal.

孝顺.zh: 他很孝顺，每个周末都回家看望父母。
孝顺.en: He is a devoted son and goes home to visit his parents every weekend.

斜.zh: 墙上的画挂斜了，你帮我调一下。
斜.en: The picture on the wall is hanging crooked; help me straighten it.

写作.zh: 她从小就喜欢写作，现在是一名作家。
写作.en: She has loved writing since she was little, and now she is an author.

心理.zh: 考试前他的心理压力很大。
心理.en: He was under a lot of psychological pressure before the exam.

心脏.zh: 爷爷的心脏不太好，不能太累。
心脏.en: Grandpa has a weak heart and mustn't get too tired.

信任.zh: 他做事很认真，老板非常信任他。
信任.en: He is very conscientious, so his boss trusts him a lot.

行为.zh: 在公共场所大声说话是不礼貌的行为。
行为.en: Talking loudly in public places is impolite behaviour.

形容.zh: 我不知道该怎么形容当时的心情。
形容.en: I don't know how to describe how I felt at the time.

形势.zh: 现在的经济形势对我们很不利。
形势.en: The current economic situation is very unfavorable to us.

形状.zh: 这些饼干有各种各样的形状，孩子们很喜欢。
形状.en: These cookies come in all kinds of shapes, and the children love them.

幸运.zh: 能遇到这么好的老师，我真幸运。
幸运.en: I'm really lucky to have met such a good teacher.

兄弟.zh: 他们兄弟俩长得一点儿也不像。
兄弟.en: The two brothers don't look alike at all.

虚心.zh: 我们应该虚心接受别人的批评。
虚心.en: We should accept other people's criticism with an open mind.

宣布.zh: 校长宣布明天放假一天。
宣布.en: The principal announced that tomorrow will be a day off.

学术.zh: 他在这个领域发表了很多学术文章。
学术.en: He has published many academic papers in this field.

询问.zh: 警察向周围的人询问了当时的情况。
询问.en: The police asked the people nearby about what had happened.

训练.zh: 运动员们每天都要进行严格的训练。
训练.en: The athletes go through strict training every day.

押金.zh: 租这套房子要先交一个月的押金。
押金.en: To rent this apartment, you first have to pay one month's deposit.

牙齿.zh: 每天早晚刷牙才能保护好牙齿。
牙齿.en: Brushing morning and night is the way to keep your teeth healthy.

宴会.zh: 公司明天晚上要举行一个宴会。
宴会.en: The company is holding a banquet tomorrow evening.

痒.zh: 被蚊子咬了以后，我的胳膊痒得很难受。
痒.en: After being bitten by a mosquito, my arm itched terribly.

样式.zh: 这家店的衣服样式很多，你可以慢慢挑。
样式.en: This shop has lots of clothing styles, so take your time choosing.

腰.zh: 他搬了一天的东西，腰疼得厉害。
腰.en: After moving things all day, his lower back hurts badly.

咬.zh: 他小时候被狗咬过，所以很怕狗。
咬.en: He was bitten by a dog as a child, so he's afraid of dogs.

夜.en: He didn't sleep well all last night.

业余.zh: 他业余时间喜欢画画儿。
业余.en: In his spare time he likes to paint.

依然.zh: 虽然已经过了十年，这里依然没有什么变化。
依然.en: Although ten years have passed, this place still hasn't changed much.

一旦.zh: 一旦做出了决定，就不要轻易改变。
一旦.en: Once you've made a decision, don't change it lightly.

一致.zh: 经过讨论，大家终于达成了一致。
一致.en: After discussion, everyone finally reached agreement.

一再.zh: 医生一再提醒他要少喝酒。
一再.en: The doctor reminded him again and again to drink less.

移民.zh: 他们全家十年前移民到了加拿大。
移民.en: His whole family emigrated to Canada ten years ago.

疑问.zh: 如果你还有什么疑问，可以随时问我。
疑问.en: If you have any more questions, feel free to ask me anytime.

以来.zh: 今年以来，这里的房价一直在上涨。
以来.en: Since the start of this year, house prices here have kept rising.

意外.zh: 听到他要结婚的消息，大家都很意外。
意外.en: Everyone was surprised to hear that he was getting married.

议论.zh: 大家都在议论这次考试的结果。
议论.en: Everyone is talking about the results of this exam.

义务.zh: 保护环境是每个人的义务。
义务.en: Protecting the environment is everyone's duty.

因素.zh: 影响健康的因素有很多，比如饮食和睡眠。
因素.en: Many factors affect health, such as diet and sleep.

英俊.zh: 她的男朋友长得又高又英俊。
英俊.en: Her boyfriend is tall and handsome.

营养.zh: 鸡蛋和牛奶都很有营养。
营养.en: Eggs and milk are both very nutritious.

硬.zh: 这块面包放了好几天，已经变得很硬了。
硬.en: This bread has been sitting for days and has gone hard.

应付.zh: 工作太多了，我一个人应付不过来。
应付.en: There's too much work; I can't cope with it on my own.

应用.zh: 这项新技术已经被广泛应用到生活中。
应用.en: This new technology has already been widely applied in everyday life.

拥挤.zh: 上下班的时候，地铁里非常拥挤。
拥挤.en: During rush hour, the subway is extremely crowded.

勇气.zh: 他终于鼓起勇气向她表白了。
勇气.en: He finally plucked up the courage to tell her how he felt.

用功.zh: 他学习非常用功，每天都学到很晚。
用功.en: He studies very hard and stays up late studying every day.

优惠.zh: 现在买机票有优惠，可以打八折。
优惠.en: There's a discount on plane tickets right now: 20% off.

优势.en: Being young is your greatest advantage.

悠久.zh: 中国是一个历史悠久的国家。
悠久.en: China is a country with a long history.

油炸.zh: 油炸食品吃多了对身体不好。
油炸.en: Eating too much deep-fried food is bad for your health.

有利.zh: 这个政策有利于经济的发展。
有利.en: This policy is favorable to economic development.

娱乐.zh: 周末他的娱乐活动主要是看电影。
娱乐.en: On weekends his main entertainment is watching films.

预报.zh: 天气预报说明天有大雨，记得带伞。
预报.en: The weather forecast says there will be heavy rain tomorrow, so remember to bring an umbrella.

预防.zh: 经常洗手可以预防感冒。
预防.en: Washing your hands often can help prevent colds.

圆.en: Tonight the moon is big and full.

元旦.zh: 元旦那天，我们全家去看了一场电影。
元旦.en: On New Year's Day, our whole family went to see a film.

员工.zh: 这家公司有两千多名员工。
员工.en: This company has more than two thousand employees.

愿望.zh: 希望你的愿望早日实现。
愿望.en: I hope your wish comes true soon.

晕.zh: 我坐了一天的车，现在头很晕，想躺一会儿。
晕.en: I've been on the road all day; my head is spinning and I want to lie down for a bit.

运气.zh: 这次能找到这么好的工作，完全是靠运气。
运气.en: Finding such a good job this time was entirely down to luck.

运用.zh: 学过的语法要在实际生活中运用。
运用.en: Grammar you have learned should be put to use in real life.

灾害.zh: 这场自然灾害给当地造成了很大的损失。
灾害.en: This natural disaster caused heavy losses to the area.

在乎.zh: 别人怎么说我不在乎，我只做我喜欢的事。
在乎.en: I don't care what others say; I just do what I like.

再三.zh: 经过再三考虑，他决定接受这份工作。
再三.en: After thinking it over again and again, he decided to accept the job.

赞成.en: I completely agree with your opinion.

糟糕.zh: 糟糕，我把钥匙忘在办公室了！
糟糕.en: Oh no, I left my keys in the office!

造成.zh: 这次事故造成了很大的损失。

责备.zh: 他做错了事，妈妈却没有责备他。
责备.en: He did something wrong, but his mother didn't blame him.

窄.zh: 这条路太窄了，两辆车没法同时通过。
窄.en: This road is too narrow for two cars to pass at the same time.

展开.zh: 大家围绕这个问题展开了激烈的讨论。
展开.en: Everyone launched into a heated discussion on this issue.

掌握.zh: 学习外语，首先要掌握基本语法。
掌握.en: To learn a foreign language, you first need to master the basic grammar.

账户.zh: 工资每个月会直接打到你的账户里。
账户.en: Your salary will be paid directly into your account every month.

珍惜.zh: 我们要珍惜现在的幸福生活。
珍惜.en: We should cherish the happy life we have now.

阵.zh: 下午突然下了一阵大雨。
阵.en: There was a sudden burst of heavy rain in the afternoon.

睁.zh: 他累得连眼睛都睁不开了。
睁.en: He was so tired he couldn't even keep his eyes open.

争取.zh: 我会努力争取这次出国学习的机会。
争取.en: I'll do my best to win this chance to study abroad.

整个.zh: 整个下午他都在图书馆看书。
整个.en: He spent the whole afternoon reading in the library.

整齐.zh: 教室里的桌椅摆得很整齐。
整齐.en: The desks and chairs in the classroom are arranged very neatly.

正.zh: 我正要给你打电话，你就来了。
正.en: I was just about to call you when you showed up.

政府.zh: 政府决定加大对教育的投入。
政府.en: The government decided to increase its investment in education.

证件.zh: 办理入住的时候，请出示您的证件。
证件.en: Please show your ID when you check in.

支.zh: 能把你那支笔借我用一下吗？
支.en: Could I borrow that pen of yours for a moment?

支票.zh: 现在用支票付款的人越来越少了。
支票.en: Fewer and fewer people pay by check these days.

指导.zh: 在老师的指导下，我顺利完成了论文。
指导.en: Under my teacher's guidance, I successfully finished my thesis.

制定.zh: 新学期开始了，我给自己制定了一个学习计划。
制定.en: The new term has begun, and I've drawn up a study plan for myself.

制造.zh: 这家工厂专门制造汽车零件。
制造.en: This factory specializes in manufacturing car parts.

智慧.zh: 这本书里充满了生活的智慧。
智慧.en: This book is full of the wisdom of life.

秩序.zh: 请大家排好队上车，保持良好的秩序。
秩序.en: Please line up to board and keep things orderly.

中介.zh: 我们是通过中介租到这套房子的。
中介.en: We rented this apartment through an agency.

中旬.zh: 我们计划在十月中旬出发去旅游。
中旬.en: We plan to set off on our trip in mid-October.

周到.zh: 这家酒店的服务非常周到。
周到.en: The service at this hotel is very attentive.

逐步.zh: 经过努力，他的汉语水平正在逐步提高。
逐步.en: Through hard work, his Chinese is gradually improving.

竹子.en: Pandas love eating bamboo most of all.

主持.zh: 这次会议由王经理主持。
主持.en: This meeting will be chaired by Manager Wang.

主观.zh: 你的看法太主观了，应该多听听别人的意见。
主观.en: Your view is too subjective; you should listen more to other people's opinions.

主题.zh: 这次演讲比赛的主题是环境保护。
主题.en: The theme of this speech contest is environmental protection.

主任.zh: 有问题可以直接去找我们办公室主任。
主任.en: If you have a problem, you can go straight to our office director.

抓.zh: 过马路的时候，孩子紧紧地抓着妈妈的手。
抓.en: When crossing the road, the child held tightly onto his mother's hand.

专家.zh: 专家建议每天至少睡七个小时。
专家.en: Experts recommend sleeping at least seven hours a day.

专心.zh: 上课的时候要专心听讲，不要玩手机。
专心.en: In class you should listen attentively and not play on your phone.

转告.zh: 请你转告他，明天的会议改到下午了。
转告.en: Please tell him that tomorrow's meeting has been moved to the afternoon.

装.zh: 他把书都装进了箱子里。
装.en: He packed all the books into the box.

装修.zh: 我们的新房子还在装修，下个月才能搬进去。
装修.en: Our new home is still being renovated; we can't move in until next month.

状况.zh: 最近公司的经济状况不太好。
状况.en: The company's financial situation hasn't been good lately.

追.zh: 那只小狗一直在后面追着我跑。
追.en: That little dog kept chasing after me.

资格.zh: 只有会员才有资格参加这个活动。
资格.en: Only members are eligible to take part in this event.

资料.zh: 为了写论文，我在图书馆查了很多资料。
资料.en: I looked up a lot of material in the library to write my thesis.

姿势.zh: 写字的时候要注意保持正确的姿势。
姿势.en: When writing, make sure to keep a correct posture.

紫.zh: 她穿了一条紫色的裙子，非常漂亮。
紫.en: She wore a purple skirt and looked very pretty.

字幕.zh: 看外国电影的时候，我一般会打开中文字幕。
字幕.en: When I watch foreign films, I usually turn on Chinese subtitles.

自动.zh: 这种门有人走近时会自动打开。
自动.en: This kind of door opens automatically when someone approaches.

自由.zh: 大学生活比高中自由多了。
自由.en: University life is much freer than high school.

综合.zh: 这次考试主要考查学生的综合能力。
综合.en: This exam mainly tests students' overall ability.

总共.zh: 这次旅行我们总共花了五千块钱。
总共.en: We spent five thousand yuan in total on this trip.

总理.zh: 总理明天将访问欧洲三个国家。
总理.en: The premier will visit three European countries tomorrow.

总算.zh: 等了一个多小时，公共汽车总算来了。
总算.en: After waiting over an hour, the bus finally came.

总之.zh: 总之，我们必须在周五以前完成这个任务。
总之.en: In short, we must finish this task before Friday.

组成.zh: 这个乐队由五个年轻人组成。
组成.en: This band is made up of five young people.

组织.zh: 学校组织学生去博物馆参观。
组织.en: The school organized a trip for students to visit the museum.

作文.zh: 老师让我们写一篇题目为“我的家乡”的作文。
作文.en: The teacher asked us to write an essay titled "My Hometown".

哎.zh: 哎，你的钥匙掉在地上了！
哎.en: Hey, you dropped your keys on the floor!

爱护.zh: 我们要爱护花草树木，保护环境。
爱护.en: We should take care of plants and trees and protect the environment.

爱惜.zh: 我们要爱惜粮食，不要浪费。
爱惜.en: We should value food and not waste it.

安装.zh: 师傅明天上午来给我们安装空调。
安装.en: The technician will come tomorrow morning to install our air conditioner.

暗.zh: 房间里太暗了，帮我把灯打开吧。
暗.en: It's too dark in the room; please turn on the light for me.

把握.zh: 这是个好机会，你一定要把握住。
把握.en: This is a great opportunity; you must seize it.

摆.zh: 桌子上摆着一盆漂亮的花。
摆.en: A pot of pretty flowers is set out on the table.

办理.zh: 我明天要去银行办理一些手续。
办理.en: Tomorrow I need to go to the bank to take care of some paperwork.

傍晚.zh: 每天傍晚，爷爷都会去公园散步。
傍晚.en: Every day toward evening, Grandpa goes for a walk in the park.

包裹.zh: 我去邮局取了一个包裹。
包裹.en: I went to the post office to pick up a parcel.

包括.zh: 这次旅行的费用包括住宿和三餐。
包括.en: The cost of this trip includes accommodation and three meals a day.

薄.zh: 天气冷了，只穿一件薄衬衫可不行。
薄.en: It's gotten cold; just a thin shirt won't do.

宝贝.zh: 这些老照片是奶奶最珍惜的宝贝。
宝贝.en: These old photos are Grandma's most cherished treasures.

保持.zh: 毕业以后，我们一直保持着联系。
保持.en: We have kept in touch ever since graduating.

保险.zh: 出国旅游前最好买一份保险。
保险.en: It's best to buy insurance before travelling abroad.

抱怨.zh: 他总是抱怨工作太累，工资太低。
抱怨.en: He always complains that his job is too tiring and the pay is too low.

报道.zh: 这家报纸详细报道了那次交通事故。
报道.en: This newspaper reported on that traffic accident in detail.

报社.zh: 她大学毕业后在一家报社当记者。
报社.en: After graduating from university, she became a reporter at a newspaper.

背.zh: 他搬了一天箱子，背疼得厉害。
背.en: He moved boxes all day, and his back hurts badly.

本质.zh: 这两个问题在本质上是一样的。
本质.en: These two problems are essentially the same.

彼此.zh: 我们认识多年，彼此都很了解。
彼此.en: We've known each other for years and understand each other well.

毕竟.zh: 别生他的气了，他毕竟还是个孩子。
毕竟.en: Don't be angry with him; he's only a child, after all.

避免.zh: 开车时要集中注意力，避免发生事故。
避免.en: Concentrate when driving to avoid accidents.

编辑.zh: 她在一家杂志社当编辑。
编辑.en: She works as an editor at a magazine.

便.zh: 他一下课便去图书馆了。
便.en: As soon as class ended, he went to the library.

标点.zh: 写完作文以后，要检查一下标点有没有用错。
标点.en: After writing an essay, check whether any punctuation is used wrongly.

表明.zh: 调查结果表明，大多数人支持这个计划。
表明.en: The survey results show that most people support this plan.

病毒.zh: 我的电脑好像中病毒了。
病毒.en: My computer seems to have caught a virus.

播放.zh: 电视台正在播放今年的春节晚会。
播放.en: The TV station is broadcasting this year's Spring Festival Gala.

脖子.zh: 天气冷了，出门记得围上围巾，别冻着脖子。
脖子.en: It's getting cold; remember to wear a scarf when you go out so your neck doesn't get cold.

不要紧.zh: 只是一点儿小伤，不要紧，你别担心。
不要紧.en: It's only a small injury, nothing serious, so don't worry.

布.zh: 这块布可以用来做一条裙子。
布.en: This piece of cloth can be used to make a skirt.

不安.zh: 考试结果还没出来，他心里很不安。
不安.en: The exam results aren't out yet, and he feels very uneasy.

不得了.zh: 听到这个好消息，她高兴得不得了。
不得了.en: When she heard the good news, she was extremely happy.

不如.zh: 我的汉语说得不如他流利。
不如.en: My Chinese isn't as fluent as his.

步骤.zh: 请按照说明书上的步骤进行操作。
步骤.en: Please follow the steps in the instructions.

采访.zh: 记者采访了几位参加比赛的运动员。
采访.en: The reporter interviewed several athletes taking part in the competition.

彩虹.zh: 雨停了，天空中出现了一道彩虹。
彩虹.en: The rain stopped, and a rainbow appeared in the sky.

参与.zh: 老师鼓励每个学生积极参与课堂讨论。
参与.en: The teacher encourages every student to take an active part in class discussions.

惭愧.zh: 我没能按时完成任务，感到很惭愧。
惭愧.en: I feel very ashamed that I didn't finish the task on time.

操心.zh: 孩子已经长大了，你就别再为他操心了。
操心.en: Your child is grown up now; stop worrying about him.

册.zh: 这套小说一共有三册，我已经看完了第一册。
册.en: This novel comes in three volumes, and I've finished the first one.

测验.zh: 老师明天要测验我们上周学的生词。
测验.en: Tomorrow the teacher is going to test us on the new words we learned last week.

曾经.zh: 我曾经在上海工作过三年。
曾经.en: I once worked in Shanghai for three years.

差距.en: The income gap between cities and the countryside is still large.

产品.zh: 这家公司的产品质量很好。
产品.en: This company's products are of very good quality.

长途.en: After more than ten hours on a long-distance bus, he was exhausted.

抄.zh: 考试的时候抄别人的答案是不对的。
抄.en: Copying other people's answers during an exam is wrong.

超级.zh: 这部电影超级好看，你一定要去看！
超级.en: This movie is super good; you have to go see it!

朝.zh: 我家的窗户朝南，冬天阳光很好。
朝.en: Our windows face south, so we get lots of sunshine in winter.

炒.zh: 妈妈炒了几个我爱吃的菜。
炒.en: Mum stir-fried a few of my favourite dishes.

吵架.en: The two of them quarreled over a trivial matter yesterday.

车厢.en: This carriage is too crowded; let's go to the back.

沉默.zh: 听了这个问题，他沉默了很久才回答。
沉默.en: Hearing the question, he was silent for a long time before answering.

称呼.zh: 第一次见面，我不知道该怎么称呼他。
称呼.en: Meeting him for the first time, I didn't know how to address him.

承认.zh: 他终于承认自己做错了。
承认.en: He finally admitted that he was wrong.

程度.zh: 我的汉语还没达到能看懂报纸的程度。
程度.en: My Chinese hasn't yet reached the level where I can read newspapers.

成分.zh: 这种饮料的主要成分是水和糖。
成分.en: The main ingredients of this drink are water and sugar.

成果.zh: 这项研究成果得到了专家们的肯定。
成果.en: The results of this research were recognized by experts.

成就.zh: 她在科学研究方面取得了很大的成就。
成就.en: She has made great achievements in scientific research.

成熟.zh: 经过这件事，他变得成熟多了。
成熟.en: After this experience, he became much more mature.

成长.zh: 父母都希望孩子健康快乐地成长。
成长.en: All parents hope their children grow up healthy and happy.

吃亏.en: He is too honest, so he often loses out.

迟早.zh: 只要你坚持努力，迟早会成功的。
迟早.en: As long as you keep working hard, you'll succeed sooner or later.

池塘.zh: 公园的池塘里有很多小鱼在游来游去。
池塘.en: Lots of little fish are swimming around in the pond in the park.

翅膀.en: The little bird spread its wings and flew into the sky.

充电器.en: I forgot my phone charger. Could I borrow yours for a bit?

充满.zh: 年轻人总是充满了活力。
充满.en: Young people are always full of energy.

抽屉.zh: 钥匙就放在桌子的抽屉里。
抽屉.en: The keys are in the desk drawer.

臭.en: The garbage stinks; take it out and throw it away right now.

出版.zh: 他的第一本小说明年就要出版了。
出版.en: His first novel will be published next year.

出色.zh: 她在工作中表现得非常出色，受到了领导的表扬。
出色.en: She has done outstanding work and was praised by her boss.

初级.zh: 我刚开始学汉语，现在在上初级班。
初级.en: I've just started learning Chinese, so I'm in a beginner class.

传播.zh: 网络让信息传播得越来越快。
传播.en: The internet makes information spread faster and faster.

传说.zh: 关于这个湖，有一个美丽的传说。
传说.en: There is a beautiful legend about this lake.

窗帘.en: The sunlight is too strong; let's draw the curtains.

创造.en: This athlete set a new world record.

词汇.zh: 多读书可以帮助你扩大词汇量。
词汇.en: Reading more can help you expand your vocabulary.

辞职.zh: 她因为压力太大，上个月辞职了。
辞职.en: She resigned last month because the pressure was too great.

刺激.zh: 这部电影的情节非常刺激。
刺激.en: The plot of this film is really thrilling.

从此.en: They had a big fight, and since then they have never been in touch.

从事.en: Since graduating from university, he has worked in education.

促进.zh: 旅游业的发展促进了当地经济的增长。
促进.en: The development of tourism has boosted the growth of the local economy.

催.zh: 妈妈一直催我早点儿结婚。
催.en: My mother keeps pushing me to get married soon.

存在.en: There are still some problems with this plan.

答应.en: I asked him for help, and he readily agreed.

达到.en: In this exam he finally reached his goal.

打交道.en: In sales, you have to deal with all kinds of people every day.

打喷嚏.en: He has a cold and keeps sneezing.

打听.zh: 我向邻居打听了一下附近哪儿有银行。
打听.en: I asked a neighbor where there was a bank nearby.

大方.en: He is very generous and often treats his friends to meals.

呆.en: When he heard the news, he was stunned.

代替.en: Mr. Wang is ill, so Ms. Li is teaching his class in his place today.

贷款.zh: 他向银行贷款买了一套房子。
贷款.en: He took out a bank loan to buy a flat.

单纯.zh: 她是个很单纯的女孩，很容易相信别人。
单纯.en: She's a very innocent girl who trusts people easily.

单独.en: I'd like to talk with you alone.

单元.zh: 这本书一共有十个单元，我们已经学了一半。
单元.en: This book has ten units in total, and we've already covered half of them.

胆小鬼.en: Scared of even such a tiny bug? What a coward!

当地.zh: 去旅游时，我喜欢尝尝当地的特色菜。
当地.en: When I travel, I like to try the local specialties.

当心.zh: 路上有冰，开车一定要当心！
当心.en: There's ice on the road; be careful when you drive!

挡.zh: 一辆大卡车挡住了我们的路。
挡.en: A big truck blocked our way.

岛屿.zh: 印度尼西亚是一个由很多岛屿组成的国家。
岛屿.en: Indonesia is a country made up of many islands.

导演.zh: 这部电影的导演非常有名。
导演.en: The director of this film is very famous.

导致.en: Lack of sleep can lead to poor concentration.

到达.zh: 火车将于下午三点到达北京。
到达.en: The train will arrive in Beijing at 3 p.m.

道德.zh: 为了钱欺骗朋友，这样做太不道德了。
道德.en: Deceiving a friend for money is really immoral.

等待.zh: 大家耐心等待了两个小时，飞机终于起飞了。
等待.en: Everyone waited patiently for two hours, and the plane finally took off.

的确.zh: 这个办法的确不错，我们试试吧。
的确.en: This method really is good; let's give it a try.

地道.zh: 他在北京住了十年，汉语说得很地道。
地道.en: He has lived in Beijing for ten years and speaks very authentic Chinese.

地理.en: I've been interested in geography since I was little and love looking at maps.

地区.zh: 这个地区的冬天特别冷。
地区.en: Winters in this region are especially cold.

地位.zh: 这家公司在行业中的地位越来越高。
地位.en: This company's standing in the industry keeps rising.

点心.zh: 下午我们一边喝茶，一边吃点心。
点心.en: In the afternoon we had tea and pastries.

电台.zh: 我每天开车的时候都听电台节目。

钓.zh: 爷爷周末喜欢去河边钓鱼。

豆腐.zh: 我最喜欢喝妈妈做的豆腐汤。
豆腐.en: My favorite is the tofu soup my mom makes.

独立.zh: 孩子长大后要学会独立生活。
独立.en: When children grow up, they need to learn to live independently.

断.zh: 刮了一夜大风，好几根树枝都断了。
断.en: After a night of strong wind, several branches snapped.

堆.en: There is a pile of old newspapers on his desk.

对象.en: The subjects of this survey are mainly college students.

兑换.en: I'd like to exchange RMB for US dollars.

蹲.en: He crouched on the ground looking for the keys he had dropped.

多余.zh: 这句话是多余的，可以去掉。
多余.en: This sentence is unnecessary; it can be taken out.

躲藏.zh: 小猫躲藏在床底下，怎么叫也不出来。
躲藏.en: The kitten is hiding under the bed and won't come out however much you call it.

恶劣.zh: 由于天气恶劣，今天的航班都被取消了。
恶劣.en: Due to severe weather, all of today's flights were canceled.

耳环.zh: 这对耳环是妈妈送给我的生日礼物。
耳环.en: This pair of earrings was a birthday present from my mom.

发愁.zh: 他正为找工作的事发愁呢。
发愁.en: He's worrying about finding a job.

发抖.zh: 外面太冷了，她冻得直发抖。
发抖.en: It was so cold outside that she was shivering nonstop.

发明.en: Do you know who invented the telephone?

翻.en: Everyone, please turn your books to page twenty.

反复.zh: 这篇课文我反复读了好几遍。
反复.en: I read this text over and over, several times.

反映.zh: 这部小说反映了当时农民的生活。
反映.en: This novel reflects the lives of farmers at that time.

方.zh: 这张桌子是方的，那张是圆的。
方.en: This table is square, and that one is round.

仿佛.zh: 看着这些老照片，我仿佛回到了小时候。
仿佛.en: Looking at these old photos, it felt as if I were back in my childhood.

非.en: You are the one who has to go and handle this.

废话.zh: 别说废话了，我们快点儿开始吧。
废话.en: Stop talking nonsense; let's get started.

分别.en: When she parted from her old friend, she couldn't help crying.

分配.zh: 经理把任务分配给了每个人。
分配.en: The manager assigned tasks to each person.

分析.zh: 我们先分析一下失败的原因吧。
分析.en: Let's first analyse the reasons for the failure.

纷纷.zh: 听到这个消息，大家纷纷表示支持。
纷纷.en: On hearing the news, people expressed their support one after another.

奋斗.zh: 为了实现自己的理想，他一直在努力奋斗。
奋斗.en: He has been striving hard to realize his dreams.

风格.zh: 我很喜欢这位作家的写作风格。
风格.en: I really like this writer's writing style.

风俗.zh: 每个地方都有自己的风俗习惯。
风俗.en: Every place has its own customs and habits.

疯狂.zh: 球迷们为自己喜欢的球队疯狂地欢呼。
疯狂.en: The fans cheered wildly for their favourite team.

否定.en: The manager rejected our plan, thinking it was too risky.

幅.en: A very beautiful painting hangs on the wall.

服装.en: This shop mainly sells children's clothing.

辅导.en: Every evening, the older sister helps her little brother with his homework.

妇女.zh: 现在越来越多的妇女走上了领导岗位。
妇女.en: More and more women are now taking on leadership positions.

改革.en: The school decided to reform the examination system.

改善.en: In recent years, people's living conditions have greatly improved.

盖.en: It's getting cold, so tuck the quilt in well when you sleep.

概念.en: This concept is a bit complicated, so the teacher explained it again.

干脆.zh: 既然这么麻烦，我们干脆别去了。
干脆.en: Since it's such a hassle, let's just not go.

干燥.zh: 北方的冬天很干燥，要多喝水。
干燥.en: Winters in the north are very dry, so you should drink plenty of water.

感激.zh: 对于大家的帮助，我非常感激。
感激.en: I am very grateful for everyone's help.

感受.zh: 这次旅行让我感受到了当地人的热情。
感受.en: This trip let me feel the warmth of the local people.

赶紧.zh: 快下雨了，我们赶紧回家吧。
赶紧.en: It's about to rain; let's hurry home.

钢铁.en: This bridge is built of steel and is very sturdy.

高档.en: This restaurant is very upscale, and the dishes are expensive too.

搞.en: We must get this matter straight before making a decision.

格外.en: The air is especially fresh after the rain.

个别.zh: 除了个别同学以外，大家都通过了考试。
个别.en: Apart from one or two students, everyone passed the exam.

个性.en: He's someone with a lot of personality.

根.en: He took a banana from the table.

公布.zh: 考试成绩明天就会公布。
公布.en: The exam results will be announced tomorrow.

公元.zh: 这座寺庙建于公元七世纪。
公元.en: This temple was built in the 7th century AD.

公主.en: The little girl loves stories about princes and princesses most of all.

工程师.en: After graduating from university he became an engineer.

工人.zh: 工厂里的工人每天工作八个小时。
工人.en: The workers in the factory work eight hours a day.

恭喜.zh: 恭喜你顺利通过了这次考试！

贡献.en: He made a great contribution to the country's economic development.

构成.zh: 这本书由十二个小故事构成。
构成.en: This book is made up of twelve short stories.

姑姑.zh: 我姑姑是我爸爸的妹妹，她在上海工作。
姑姑.en: My aunt is my dad's younger sister; she works in Shanghai.

古典.en: She especially likes listening to classical music, particularly piano pieces.

鼓舞.zh: 这个好消息让大家深受鼓舞。
鼓舞.en: This good news greatly lifted everyone's spirits.

股票.zh: 他去年买的股票最近涨了不少。
股票.en: The stocks he bought last year have risen quite a bit recently.

固定.en: He has no steady job, and his income is unstable too.

挂号.en: When you see a doctor at the hospital, you have to register first.

拐弯.zh: 到了前面的路口往右拐弯，就是邮局。
拐弯.en: Turn right at the next junction and you'll find the post office.

官.zh: 他爷爷年轻的时候当过官。
官.en: His grandfather was a government official when he was young.

关闭.zh: 飞机起飞前，请关闭您的手机。
关闭.en: Please switch off your mobile phone before the plane takes off.

观点.zh: 对于这个问题，每个人都有不同的观点。
观点.en: Everyone has a different point of view on this issue.

管子.zh: 这根管子漏水了，得找人来修一下。

光盘.en: This textbook comes with a CD you can use to listen to the lesson recordings.

广场.zh: 每天晚上都有很多老人在广场上跳舞。
广场.en: Every evening many elderly people dance in the square.

广泛.zh: 这个问题引起了社会的广泛关注。
广泛.en: This issue has attracted wide public attention.

规矩.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的规矩。
规矩.en: Every family has its own rules.

规模.zh: 这家公司的规模越来越大了。
规模.en: This company keeps growing in scale.

归纳.en: Please sum up the main points of this article.

柜台.en: Please go to the front desk on the first floor to check out.

果然.zh: 天气预报说今天有雨，下午果然下起来了。
果然.en: The forecast said it would rain today, and sure enough, it started in the afternoon.

过分.en: Isn't it a bit too much to criticize him like that?

过期.en: This bottle of milk has expired; you can't drink it any more.

哈.zh: 听了他的笑话，大家都哈哈大笑起来。
哈.en: Everyone burst out laughing at his joke.

海关.en: Your luggage has to be inspected when you go through customs.

喊.en: I shouted to him loudly from behind, but he didn't hear me.

行业.zh: 他在旅游行业工作了十几年。
行业.en: He has worked in the tourism industry for over ten years.

好客.en: The people here are very warm and hospitable.

和平.en: We should work together to maintain world peace.

何况.zh: 这道题连老师都不会做，何况我们呢？

蝴蝶.en: A few butterflies are fluttering among the flowers in the garden.

幻想.en: He always fantasizes about becoming a star one day.

恢复.en: After a few days' rest, he has fully recovered.

火柴.en: The power went out, so he lit a candle with a match.

激烈.en: Competition for jobs is getting fiercer and fiercer.

肌肉.en: After exercising, the muscles in his legs felt sore.

记录.en: Please write down what is discussed in the meeting.

假设.en: Suppose you were the boss; how would you handle this problem?

嫁.en: She married a doctor five years older than her.

肩膀.en: He gently patted me on the shoulder.

教练.en: Under his coach's guidance, his results improved quickly.

可靠.zh: 他做事认真负责，是个可靠的人。
可靠.en: He is conscientious and responsible, a reliable person.

克服.zh: 只要我们一起努力，就一定能克服困难。
克服.en: As long as we work together, we can definitely overcome the difficulties.

刻苦.en: She studied extremely hard and finally got into her dream university.

夸张.en: You're exaggerating; things aren't that serious.

会计.en: She studied accounting at university and now works at a bank.

宽.en: This road is very wide, and there isn't much traffic.

朗读.en: The teacher had us read the text aloud.

老实.en: He's an honest man and never tells lies.

老婆.en: Every day after work he goes home early to be with his wife.

乐观.en: Whatever difficulties he runs into, he always stays optimistic.

零食.en: Eat fewer snacks and more fruit and vegetables.

命运.en: Everyone should take their fate into their own hands.

培训.en: New employees have to attend two weeks of training before starting work.

青.zh: 春天来了，山上的草都青了。

失业.en: Since losing his job, he has been looking for a new one.

实现.en: After years of hard work, he finally realised his dream.

收获.en: I gained a great deal from studying in China this time.

蔬菜.en: The doctor advised me to eat more vegetables and fruit.

私人.en: This is my private business, so please don't ask.

随手.en: Please turn off the lights on your way out.

太太.en: Mr. Wang and his wife often go for walks together.

谈判.en: The negotiations between the two companies went smoothly.

坦率.en: Frankly speaking, I don't really agree with your plan.

烫.en: The water is too hot; be careful not to scald your hand.

特征.en: Every ethnic group has its own cultural characteristics.

体现.en: This work fully reflects the author's love of life.

投入.en: He put all his energy into his work.

学问.zh: 王教授很有学问，大家都很尊敬他。
学问.en: Professor Wang is very learned, and everyone respects him.

血.zh: 他的手指被刀划破了，流了很多血。
血.en: He cut his finger on a knife and lost a lot of blood.

寻找.zh: 他一直在寻找适合自己的工作。
寻找.en: He has been looking for a job that suits him.

迅速.zh: 这座城市发展得非常迅速。
迅速.en: This city has developed very rapidly.

延长.zh: 因为问题太多，会议延长了半个小时。
延长.en: Because there were so many issues, the meeting was extended by half an hour.

严肃.zh: 开会的时候，他的表情非常严肃。
严肃.en: During the meeting, his expression was very serious.

演讲.zh: 他在毕业典礼上做了一次精彩的演讲。
演讲.en: He gave a wonderful speech at the graduation ceremony.

阳台.zh: 我们家的阳台上种了很多花。
阳台.en: We grow a lot of flowers on our balcony.

摇.zh: 我问他去不去，他摇了摇头。
摇.en: I asked him whether he was going, and he shook his head.

要不.zh: 快点儿走吧，要不就赶不上火车了。
要不.en: Let's hurry, otherwise we'll miss the train.

业务.zh: 她负责公司在海外的业务。
业务.en: She is in charge of the company's overseas business.

一辈子.zh: 我一辈子也忘不了那一天。
一辈子.en: I'll never forget that day as long as I live.

一律.zh: 本店所有商品一律打八折。
一律.en: Every item in this store is 20% off, without exception.

移动.zh: 请把桌子往左边移动一点儿。
移动.en: Please move the table a little to the left.

遗憾.zh: 很遗憾，我不能参加你的婚礼了。
遗憾.en: I'm very sorry that I can't come to your wedding.

乙.zh: 合同签好以后，甲方和乙方都必须遵守。
乙.en: Once the contract is signed, both Party A and Party B must abide by it.

以及.zh: 会议讨论了工资、假期以及其他问题。
以及.en: The meeting discussed wages, holidays and other issues.

亿.en: China has a population of more than 1.4 billion.

意义.zh: 这次活动对孩子们来说很有意义。
意义.en: This activity is very meaningful for the children.

因而.zh: 他平时学习很努力，因而取得了很好的成绩。
因而.en: He always studies hard, and as a result he got excellent grades.

银.zh: 她脖子上戴着一条银项链。
银.en: She's wearing a silver necklace around her neck.

印刷.zh: 这本书的印刷质量非常好。
印刷.en: The printing quality of this book is excellent.

英雄.zh: 救人的那位司机被大家称为英雄。
英雄.en: The driver who saved people was hailed by everyone as a hero.

迎接.zh: 全家人都到机场去迎接他。
迎接.en: The whole family went to the airport to welcome him.

营业.zh: 这家超市每天营业到晚上十点。
营业.en: This supermarket is open until ten o'clock every night.

影子.zh: 太阳快下山时，人的影子变得很长。
影子.en: When the sun is about to set, people's shadows become very long.

硬件.zh: 这台电脑的硬件太旧了，需要更新。
硬件.en: This computer's hardware is too old and needs upgrading.

拥抱.zh: 见到久别的朋友，他们紧紧地拥抱在一起。
拥抱.en: Seeing their long-lost friend, they hugged each other tightly.

用途.zh: 这种材料的用途非常广泛。
用途.en: This material has a very wide range of uses.

优美.zh: 这里环境优美，很适合散步。
优美.en: The surroundings here are beautiful and perfect for a walk.

游览.zh: 我们打算下个月去杭州游览西湖。
游览.en: We plan to go to Hangzhou next month to tour West Lake.

犹豫.zh: 他犹豫了一下，还是答应了。
犹豫.en: He hesitated for a moment, but agreed in the end.

幼儿园.zh: 每天早上，奶奶都送孙子去幼儿园。
幼儿园.en: Every morning, Grandma takes her grandson to kindergarten.

与其.zh: 与其在家里等消息，不如自己去问问。
与其.en: Rather than waiting at home for news, you'd better go and ask yourself.

语气.zh: 他说话的语气很不客气，大家都不高兴。
语气.en: He spoke in a very rude tone, and nobody was happy about it.

预订.zh: 我已经在网上预订了酒店的房间。
预订.en: I've already booked a hotel room online.

玉米.zh: 这个地方的农民主要种玉米。
玉米.en: The farmers here mainly grow corn.

原料.zh: 这种饮料的主要原料是新鲜水果。
原料.en: The main raw material of this drink is fresh fruit.

原则.zh: 不管做什么事，他都有自己的原则。
原则.en: Whatever he does, he has his own principles.

乐器.en: Can you play any musical instruments?

运输.zh: 这些水果主要靠火车运输。
运输.en: This fruit is mainly transported by train.

在于.en: The key to success lies in perseverance.

赞美.zh: 这首诗赞美了家乡美丽的景色。
赞美.en: This poem praises the beautiful scenery of the poet's hometown.

则.zh: 哥哥喜欢运动，弟弟则喜欢安静地看书。
则.en: The older brother likes sports, whereas the younger one prefers reading quietly.

摘.zh: 公园里的花不能随便摘。
摘.en: You can't just pick the flowers in the park.

粘贴.zh: 请把照片粘贴在表格的右上角。
粘贴.en: Please stick the photo in the top right corner of the form.

展览.zh: 这个博物馆正在举办一个书法展览。
展览.en: This museum is holding a calligraphy exhibition.

占.zh: 这张大床占了房间的一半。
占.en: This big bed takes up half the room.

战争.zh: 这场战争给人们带来了巨大的痛苦。
战争.en: This war brought great suffering to people.

长辈.zh: 过年的时候，我们要给长辈拜年。
长辈.en: At Chinese New Year, we pay New Year visits to our elders.

涨.zh: 最近蔬菜的价格又涨了不少。
涨.en: Vegetable prices have gone up quite a bit again recently.

招待.zh: 谢谢你们的热情招待，我们玩得很开心！
招待.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality—we had a great time!

着火.zh: 楼下的饭馆着火了，消防车马上就到了。
着火.en: The restaurant downstairs caught fire, and the fire engines arrived right away.

着凉.zh: 晚上睡觉要盖好被子，小心着凉。
着凉.en: Cover yourself well with the quilt at night so you don't catch a cold.

召开.zh: 公司下周一将召开全体员工大会。
召开.en: The company will hold an all-staff meeting next Monday.

照常.zh: 虽然下着大雨，比赛还是照常进行。
照常.en: Although it was pouring with rain, the match went ahead as usual.

哲学.zh: 他在大学里学的是哲学。

真实.zh: 这部电影是根据真实的故事改编的。
真实.en: This film is adapted from a true story.

针对.zh: 老师针对每个学生的特点制定了学习计划。
针对.en: The teacher made a study plan tailored to each student's characteristics.

诊断.zh: 医生诊断他得了严重的感冒。
诊断.en: The doctor diagnosed him with a bad cold.

振动.zh: 开会的时候，请把手机调成振动。
振动.en: During the meeting, please set your phone to vibrate.

争论.zh: 他们为这个问题争论了一个下午。
争论.en: They argued about this question for a whole afternoon.

征求.zh: 这件事我想先征求一下你的意见。
征求.en: I'd like to ask for your opinion on this matter first.

整体.zh: 我们应该从整体上考虑这个问题。
整体.en: We should consider this problem as a whole.

政治.zh: 他对政治一点儿也不感兴趣。
政治.en: He isn't interested in politics at all.

证据.zh: 警察还没有找到足够的证据。
证据.en: The police haven't found enough evidence yet.

挣.zh: 他每个月挣的钱只够付房租。
挣.en: The money he earns each month is only enough to pay the rent.

直.zh: 从这儿直走，到第二个路口往左拐。
直.en: Go straight on from here and turn left at the second intersection.

执照.zh: 他上个月刚拿到驾驶执照。
执照.en: He only got his driving licence last month.

指挥.zh: 交通警察正在路口指挥交通。
指挥.en: A traffic policeman is directing traffic at the intersection.

制度.zh: 公司今年实行了新的管理制度。
制度.en: This year the company introduced a new management system.

制作.zh: 这部电影的制作花了整整两年。
制作.en: Making this film took a full two years.

至今.zh: 那次旅行的经历，我至今还记得很清楚。
至今.en: I still remember that trip very clearly to this day.

至于.zh: 我只负责准备材料，至于开会时间，你去问经理吧。
至于.en: I'm only in charge of preparing the materials; as for the meeting time, ask the manager.

治疗.zh: 经过一个月的治疗，他的病终于好了。
治疗.en: After a month of treatment, he finally recovered from his illness.

志愿者.zh: 很多大学生报名当了运动会的志愿者。
志愿者.en: Many university students signed up as volunteers for the sports games.

中心.zh: 我家就在市中心，交通很方便。
中心.en: My home is right in the city centre, so getting around is easy.

种类.zh: 这家超市水果种类很多，价格也不贵。
种类.en: This supermarket has many kinds of fruit, and the prices aren't high.

重大.zh: 这次会议将讨论几个重大问题。
重大.en: This meeting will discuss several major issues.

重量.zh: 每位乘客行李的重量不能超过二十公斤。
重量.en: Each passenger's luggage may not weigh more than twenty kilograms.

猪.zh: 农民在院子里养了几头猪。
猪.en: The farmer keeps a few pigs in the yard.

逐渐.zh: 天气逐渐变冷了，记得多穿点儿衣服。
逐渐.en: The weather is gradually getting colder; remember to dress warmly.

煮.zh: 妈妈每天早上都给我煮一个鸡蛋。
煮.en: Every morning my mother boils an egg for me.

主动.zh: 遇到不懂的问题，他总是主动问老师。
主动.en: When he doesn't understand something, he always takes the initiative to ask the teacher.

主人.zh: 这只小狗一直在门口等主人回家。
主人.en: The little dog kept waiting at the door for its owner to come home.

主席.en: He was elected chairman of the student union.

主张.zh: 我主张大家先讨论一下，再做决定。
主张.en: I suggest that we discuss it first before making a decision.

祝福.zh: 新年到了，我向大家送上最好的祝福。
祝福.en: The New Year is here, and I send everyone my best wishes.

注册.zh: 使用这个网站以前，你需要先注册一个账号。
注册.en: Before using this website, you need to register an account first.

抓紧.zh: 离考试只有一个月了，你要抓紧时间复习。
抓紧.en: There's only a month until the exam, so you should make the most of your time to review.

转变.zh: 经过这件事，他对工作的态度发生了很大的转变。
转变.en: After this incident, his attitude toward work changed greatly.

装饰.zh: 过年的时候，大家用红灯笼装饰房子。
装饰.en: At Chinese New Year, people decorate their houses with red lanterns.

撞.zh: 他骑车时不小心撞到了一棵树。
撞.en: While riding his bike, he accidentally crashed into a tree.

状态.zh: 考试前要调整好自己的状态。
状态.en: Before an exam you should get yourself into good shape.

追求.zh: 每个人都有追求幸福的权利。
追求.en: Everyone has the right to pursue happiness.

资金.zh: 由于缺少资金，这个项目暂时停了下来。
资金.en: Due to a lack of funds, the project has been put on hold.

咨询.zh: 关于留学的问题，你可以去学校咨询一下。
咨询.en: For questions about studying abroad, you can go and ask the school for advice.

字母.zh: 英语一共有二十六个字母。
字母.en: English has twenty-six letters in total.

自从.zh: 自从搬到这里，他每天都去跑步。
自从.en: Ever since he moved here, he's gone running every day.

自豪.zh: 父母为儿子取得的成绩感到自豪。
自豪.en: The parents are proud of what their son has achieved.

自觉.zh: 学习主要靠自觉，别人没法替你。
自觉.en: Studying depends mainly on your own initiative; no one can do it for you.

自私.zh: 他太自私了，从来不考虑别人的感受。
自私.en: He's so selfish; he never considers other people's feelings.

自愿.zh: 参加这个活动完全是自愿的。
自愿.en: Taking part in this activity is entirely voluntary.

总裁.zh: 他三十岁就当上了公司的总裁。
总裁.en: He became the company's CEO at just thirty.

总统.zh: 这位总统下个月将访问中国。
总统.en: The president will visit China next month.

组.zh: 老师把我们分成四个组讨论问题。
组.en: The teacher divided us into four groups to discuss the question.

组合.zh: 这套家具可以根据需要自由组合。
组合.en: This set of furniture can be freely combined as needed.

阻止.zh: 他想说什么，却被妈妈阻止了。
阻止.en: He wanted to say something, but his mother stopped him.

醉.zh: 他昨天晚上喝醉了，今天头很疼。
醉.en: He got drunk last night and has a bad headache today.

最初.zh: 最初我并不喜欢这份工作，后来慢慢习惯了。
最初.en: At first I didn't like this job at all, but I gradually got used to it.

尊敬.zh: 他是一位受人尊敬的老教授。
尊敬.en: He is a highly respected old professor.

遵守.zh: 每个人都应该遵守交通规则。
遵守.en: Everyone should obey the traffic rules.

作品.zh: 这是他最有名的一部作品。
作品.en: This is his most famous work.

作为.zh: 作为一名老师，他对学生非常负责。
作为.en: As a teacher, he is very responsible toward his students.
